--- a/auth.py
+++ b/auth.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 def authenticate(token):
     if token == "expired":
-        return 500, "expired"
+        return 401, "expired"
     if token == "valid":
         return 200, "alice"
     return 401, "missing"
--- a/tests/test_auth_expired_token.py
+++ b/tests/test_auth_expired_token.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+from auth import authenticate
+
+
+def test_expired_token_returns_401_expired():
+    result = authenticate("expired")
+    assert result == (401, "expired")
+    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
+    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
+    assert result[0] == 401
+    assert isinstance(result[1], str)
+    assert result[1] == "expired"
+
+
+def test_expired_token_does_not_return_500():
+    status, message = authenticate("expired")
+    assert status != 500
+    assert status == 401
+    assert message == "expired"
+
+
+def test_valid_token_behavior_preserved():
+    result = authenticate("valid")
+    assert result == (200, "alice")
+    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
+    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
+    assert result[0] == 200
+    assert isinstance(result[1], str)
+    assert result[1] == "alice"
+
+
+def test_absent_token_behavior_preserved():
+    result = authenticate(None)
+    assert result == (401, "missing")
+    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
+    assert isinstance(result[0], int)
+    assert result[0] == 401
+    assert isinstance(result[1], str)
+    assert result[1] == "missing"
